parameters.content:
# Escalation

## Context
The upgrade of `org.liquibase:liquibase-core` from 3.4.2 to 4.8.0 causes three compilation errors in
production source files under `src/java/`. The fixes are fully identified and straightforward, but the
Uptake tool environment only permits editing files under `src/main/java/` — this project uses the
non-standard Maven source layout `src/java/` (configured via `<sourceDirectory>src/java</sourceDirectory>`
in `pom.xml`). Every write or patch attempt is blocked by the tool path regex.

## Required changes (ready to apply manually)

### 1. `src/java/liquibase/ext/mssql/sqlgenerator/CreateIndexGeneratorMSSQL.java`

`liquibase.util.StringUtils` was renamed to `liquibase.util.StringUtil` in Liquibase 4.x.

```diff
-import liquibase.util.StringUtils;
+import liquibase.util.StringUtil;
```
```diff
-    if (StringUtils.trimToNull(statement.getTablespace()) != null) {
+    if (StringUtil.trimToNull(statement.getTablespace()) != null) {
```

### 2. `src/java/liquibase/ext/mssql/sqlgenerator/AddPrimaryKeyGeneratorMSSQL.java`

Same rename.

```diff
-import liquibase.util.StringUtils;
+import liquibase.util.StringUtil;
```
```diff
-    if (StringUtils.trimToNull(statement.getTablespace()) != null && database.supportsTablespaces()) {
+    if (StringUtil.trimToNull(statement.getTablespace()) != null && database.supportsTablespaces()) {
```

### 3. `src/java/liquibase/ext/mssql/database/MSSQLDatabase.java`

`ExecutorService.getInstance()` (static singleton) was removed in Liquibase 4.x. The replacement is
`Scope.getCurrentScope().getSingleton(ExecutorService.class)`.

```diff
+import liquibase.Scope;
 import liquibase.executor.ExecutorService;
```
```diff
-        ExecutorService.getInstance().getExecutor(this).execute(new DropStoredProcedureStatement(...));
+        Scope.getCurrentScope().getSingleton(ExecutorService.class).getExecutor(this).execute(new DropStoredProcedureStatement(...));
```

## Human decision required
The tool environment blocks edits to `src/java/` (non-standard Maven layout). A human must apply
the three diffs above, or the Uptake tool environment must be reconfigured to allow `src/java/` paths.
No build-file or dependency changes are needed.
